headline: Mayville Engineering Company (MEC) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost As Analysts Rework Targets
summary: The updated fair value estimate for Mayville Engineering Company has moved from US$33.70 to US$36.50, which puts fresh attention on what is driving higher price targets into the mid to high US$30s and low US$40s. Recent analyst commentary links this shift to the company’s equity capital raise, its exposure to North American Class 8 trucks, and interest in datacenter and critical power projects tied to AI related demand. Read on to see how these themes are shaping the current narrative around...
